title: SpaceX prepares new Starship test with first-ever ship and booster catch attempt
detail: Brazilian outlet G1 reports SpaceX is preparing a new Starship test in which it will attempt an unprecedented maneuver: recovering both the spaceship and the Super Heavy booster.

media.caption: SpaceX prepares new Starship test with catch attempt

title: SpaceX launches Starship Flight 15 from Texas attempting first double catch of booster and ship
detail: G1 reports SpaceX launched Starship Flight 15 from Texas, its boldest test flight yet, attempting the unprecedented maneuver of catching both the Super Heavy booster and the ship.

media.caption: SpaceX launches Starship Flight 15 with double catch attempt
